cssVars: Label, input, checks and popup text

propDocs.Combobox.multiple: Select several cities; chips show and remove selected values.
propDocs.Combobox.keepQuery: Keep filtering text after choosing in multiple mode.
propDocs.Combobox.allowCustomValue: Accept unmatched text as a value.
propDocs.Combobox.autoHighlight: Always highlight on open, only while typing, or never automatically.
propDocs.Combobox.presentation: "auto" (the default here) is a popover on wide screens and a sheet from the bottom edge on small touch screens; "popover" floats everywhere; "sheet" always slides up.
